items.descZh: mantis 是由 perzianhq 开发的一个开源项目，托管在 GitHub 上，背景是专注于为 AI 代理提供轻量级解决方案。其核心功能是一个精简的浏览器界面，允许 AI 代理直接与网页交互，实现自动化操作。亮点在于集成了多种技术，如 aiagents、browserautomation、llmtools、mcp、mcpserver 和 playwright，但原文未提供具体性能数字。适用场景包括开发需要浏览器功能的 AI 应用，例如自动化测试、网页抓取或 AI 驱动的服务。
items.quote: 面向 AI 智能体的轻量级浏览器界面。

items.title: Show HN: BollyQuiz for Diwali House Parties
items.desc: description: A free Jeopardystyle Bollywood quiz for game night. Put it on the TV, pick a host and guess films from posters, emojis and songs. No signup. title: BollyQuiz: Are You Desi Enough? image: https://bollyquiz.com/assets/ogimage.jpg The quiz Three boards, played in order. Each one takes about an hour with a full room. Admit: the whole room Are You Desi Enough? 3 boards 75 questions A hidden photo on every board Posters, emoji plots, song clips, deadpan dialogue and one category written entirely in office jargon. [Play](quiz1/) Board One Bare Minimum Emoji Kahani Naam Toh Suna Hoga Antakshari Ulta Debut Ho Gaya Board Two Corporate Filmy Lost in Translation Frame Freeze Scrambled Sitaare Chori Ka Maal Board Three Joining the Dots Jodi No. 1 Dialogue Flat Box Office Bomb साल क्या था More quizzes are on the way Got an idea for a category? Send it in and it might end up on the next board. [Suggest a category](https://tally.so/r/GeKdNe) How to play this quiz Plug a laptop into the TV, press F11 and pick someone bossy to host. Here's one turn, start to finish. What you need 📺 A big screenA laptop on a TV is ideal. It's made to be read from the sofa, so it doesn't work well on phones. 🎤 One hostHolds the keyboard, reads the questions, settles the arguments. Can play along but can't win. There's an answer sheet link on the board to open on your phone. 🔔 A buzzerAny free buzzer app that shows who buzzed first. We used [MultiBuzz](https://www.multibuzz.app/). ✏️ Paper and a penThe quiz shows questions and answers but doesn't keep score, so someone honest has to. A turn 1. Pick a squareThe number on each square is how many points it's worth. 10 is the easiest, 50 the hardest. Whoever got the last one right picks next. For the first pick, the host chooses someone. 2. The host opens itEveryone sees the question at the same time. 3. Buzz to answerThe fastest buzzer gets the first guess. Wrong? You lose half the square's points, and it passes to the next fastest. Everyone gets one guess per question. 4. Score itA right answer wins the square's points, plus one shot at guessing the hidden photo. If nobody gets it, nobody scores. 5. The tile liftsThe host shows the answer, goes back to the board, and a bit more of the hidden photo shows through. Scoring Right answer The square's points, from 10 to 50 Wrong answer Lose half the square's points (−15 on a 30). Then it passes to the next buzzer Nobody gets it No one scores. The tile still lifts Photo guessed right +100 Photo guessed wrong −50, and no more photo guesses on that board Each board has 750 points on its squares. Near misses ("Om Shanti" for _Om Shanti Om_) are the host's call, so agree how strict to be before you start. The hidden photo There's a photo under every board. After you get a correct answer, you can take one guess to identify the person in the hidden photo. It could be anyone from the Bollywood industry. Right: +100\. Wrong: −50, and you can't guess the photo again on that board. The categories Board One Board Two Board Three PosterBare MinimumA minimalist poster. Guess the film. EmojiEmoji KahaniThe plot in emoji. Guess the film. CharacterNaam Toh Suna HogaA character's name. Name the film. AudioAntakshari UltaListen to the clip. Name the song and the film. DebutDebut Ho GayaWhich actor had their first lead role in this film? JargonCorporate FilmyThe plot, written as office jargon. Name the film. LyricsLost in TranslationA song's gist in plain English. Name the song (the film is a bonus). StillFrame FreezeA still with no faces and no text. Name the film. AnagramScrambled SitaareUnscramble the letters. Name the actor. RemakeChori Ka MaalA Bollywood film. Name the Hollywood film it's based on. LinkJoining the DotsWhat connects these? PairJodi No. 1These two shared the screen exactly once. Which film? DialogueDialogue FlatA famous line, read completely deadpan. Name the film. CluesBox Office BombClues appear one at a time. Name the film. Orderसाल क्या थाPut these films in release order. All three or nothing. Host shortcuts H Show every key on screen ←→ Move around the board Enter Open a square U Undo the last lift 123 Switch board S Save a backup of the game Why I made this We were planning a game session and I wanted something more fun than a phone quiz. So I made a board like [KVizzing by Kumar Varun](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCGNttcniazbrHVCAMAT63ew), with the questions best suited to our group of friends. In September 2026, I hosted the first one at home. The board went up on our TV, filmy posters went up on every wall and window. Board One on our TV, September 2026 Made with love Hi, I'm Kavya. I live in Singapore and I make small things on the internet, some for work and some just because they're fun to make [Poke & SeeTiny interactive science toys for 3 to 5 year olds._pokeandsee.com_](https://pokeandsee.com) [MRT AnnouncementsTap any of 143 stations on the Singapore MRT map and hear its announcement._For train fans_](https://kavyaj.github.io/mrtannouncements/) Settled who won? The quiz is free and stays free. If it made your night fun, you can buy me a cutting chai. items.author: kavyaj
items.descZh: BollyQuiz是由新加坡创作者Kavya打造的免费宝莱坞风格问答游戏，灵感源于朋友聚会时对电视互动游戏的需求，旨在提供比手机Quiz更沉浸式的体验。游戏采用Jeopardy机制，设三个板共75个问题，玩家需根据海报、表情符号、歌曲片段、deadpan对话等线索猜测电影，每个板还嵌入隐藏照片猜测环节。核心亮点在于完全免费无需注册，每个板总分750分，问题分值从10到50不等，隐藏照片猜对加100分猜错扣50分，类别独特如将剧情写成办公室行话或要求按上映顺序排列电影。游戏需连接电视大屏幕并由一名主持人操控键盘，支持任意免费抢答App，适合朋友或家庭游戏之夜，尤其推荐给对印度电影文化感兴趣的群体。此外，游戏提供快捷键操作、自定义判分严格度，并允许玩家提交新类别建议以持续丰富内容。
items.quote: 一个用于游戏之夜的免费宝莱坞 Jeopardy 风格问答游戏。

items.descZh: 用户对 YouTube Music 的音乐选择功能表示高度认可，认为其内容丰富且符合个人口味。然而，用户对应用的用户界面设计提出了严厉批评，认为其体验极差。该产品在音乐流媒体领域具有显著的内容优势，但UI设计成为其主要缺陷。亮点在于庞大的音乐库，但缺乏具体的性能数据来支持。适用场景为那些优先考虑音乐内容而非界面美观的用户。

items.author: joquinn
items.descZh: Stitch.ai 是本周新发布的一体化工作空间，专为知识工作者、自由职业者和创始人设计，旨在解决在不同应用与标签页之间频繁切换的痛点。该应用将邮件、日历、联系人、任务、笔记和表格等功能整合到单一界面中，用户无需跳转即可完成大部分日常工作。其核心亮点在于通过统一架构减少上下文切换，提升操作连贯性与专注度，虽然原文未给出具体性能数字，但一体化设计本身已显著简化工作流。这款产品特别适合需要高效管理多重任务、追求极简工作环境的个人与创业团队。
items.quote: 我们一直在努力为知识工作者、自由职业者和创始人提供一个无需在应用和标签页之间跳转的工作空间；一切都整合在同一个地方。

items.descZh: NEOMA PCAM 是一个针对边缘计算场景的物理反射核心项目，旨在实现确定性的低延迟响应。它在 GTX 1650 显卡上运行，核心亮点是仅需 0.27 毫秒的物理反射延迟，并结合了 ZeroTrust PoPW 账本和实时阻尼引擎，确保系统稳定和安全。该项目适用于对实时性要求极高的机器人控制、自动驾驶或高精度模拟场景，通过硬件级的确定性计算来消除传统系统的抖动。

items.author: jgfriedman1999
items.descZh: doc2struct是一个基于MIT许可证的开源算法，专门设计用于快速解析各类文档。它能够在单线程环境下高效运行，核心功能包括保留文档的嵌套结构和进行温和的表格清理。该算法的亮点在于其惊人的性能，例如可以解析大小为19GB的2025年年度报告仅需40秒。这使得它特别适用于需要快速处理大规模文档的场景，如企业年报分析或大规模数据提取任务。

items.descZh: 该产品是一款基于Prolog的反向Web应用防火墙（WAF）逻辑 perimeter 系统，其核心为原生Prolog服务器与规则系统引擎。系统在资源受限的GCP实例上运行，通过微并发机制和硬件SIMD加速，驱动包含137,217个操作子句的规则引擎。其技术亮点包括超轻量级应用 footprint（仅消耗极少内存）、零GPU依赖，以及利用Rust FFI和SIMD展开技术实现的确定性DCG多层解析器。在真实攻防环境中，该系统展现出强大的实时拦截能力，曾单次拦截63,726个恶意请求，并成功匹配超过19万个子句以识别威胁。此系统特别适用于对安全性要求极高且计算资源有限的网络边缘或云原生应用场景。

items.titleZh:
看到你分享的 NextGen WAF，这确实是个很有意思的思路。它基于 Prolog 构建，原生集成了逻辑规则引擎，让安全策略的编写和维护变得非常直观和高效。这种架构在处理复杂、多变的攻击模式时，天然就具备了很强的灵活性和可解释性。

它目前能有效拦截恶意爬虫、扫描器和 SQL 注入等攻击，对于正在探索 WAF 或者是 Prolog 在安全领域应用的朋友来说，值得一试。

items.desc: description: Research promotion channels for your software product, check eligibility and fees, prepare materials, and track your own submissions with ReachMap. title: ReachMap — Promotion channel research for software makers PROMOTION CHANNEL RESEARCH FOR SOFTWARE MAKERS Choose where to promote _your software._ ReachMap turns a product profile into a focused channel shortlist. Compare recorded requirements, prepare submission materials, and keep track of your next step in one workspace. [Start your promotion plan →](/workspacehome)[See the method](/howitworks) Start with a browser draft. Manual product setup is available. FROM RESEARCH TO A NEXT STEP A shortlist with context. 01 Describe your product Audience, stage, goals, budget and submission constraints. 02 Check channel fit Review source notes, fees, eligibility and open questions. 03 Prepare and track Keep materials, notes and selfreported submission status. Research support. Submission decisions stay with you. Early research, clearly labeled. A research match is a starting point for checking a channel, not approval to submit. Confirm the current rules and price at the channel before you act. WHAT YOU CAN DO Make a promotion plan you can review. Find a relevant starting point Explore launch platforms, software directories, AI directories and developer communities from the current research catalog. The shortlist uses your product type, tags and selected goals after known exclusions. Keep uncertainty visible Read verification labels, source dates and requirements. Unknown eligibility and prices still need confirmation. Coverage is limited and changes over time. Prepare your submission materials Keep descriptions, logo and screenshot links alongside your product profile. Use the dashboard to record notes, status and listing links after your own actions. Keep control of your draft Guest drafts stay in this browser. Export a JSON backup, or sign in with GitHub and explicitly save to your account to continue across devices. One project is stored per account. Who is ReachMap for? Independent makers and small software teams planning where to introduce an AI product, SaaS or developer tool. Product profiles also support content and agency products, though the available channel coverage may be narrower. If you need a fully managed launch or automatic directory submission, this workflow still requires you to check rules and submit directly. ReachMap does not promise acceptance, backlinks, traffic or rankings. [Read how the shortlist is made and what its labels mean →](/howitworks) Questions before you start Can I use it without website analysis? Yes. Enter your website URL in the workspace and fill in the profile manually. AI website analysis is currently disabled; the core planning workflow does not require it. Does ReachMap submit to channels for me? No. You review each channel, follow its submission route and record your own progress. A Listed status is selfreported, not independent proof of publication. Is this an AI visibility monitoring service? The public planning workflow is channel research and submission tracking. GEO research is an invitationonly preview; live monitoring is disabled. No AI citation or search visibility result is guaranteed. Will my project become a public page? Your browser draft and account project are not published as public profiles. Guest data stays in this browser until you explicitly import and save it to your account. See [privacy and data handling](/privacy) for details. Begin with what you built. Open the workspace to create your product profile. The overview also offers an illustrative sample project so you can try the workflow. [Open your workspace →](/workspacehome)

items.descZh: ReachMap是一款专为软件制造商设计的工具，旨在帮助他们系统研究推广渠道，包括检查资格、费用和准备材料。其核心功能是将产品档案转化为精准的渠道短名单，通过比较渠道要求、准备提交材料并跟踪进度，在一个工作空间中完成全流程。亮点在于提供三步结构化流程（描述产品、检查渠道匹配、准备和跟踪），并保持不确定性透明，如显示验证标签和来源日期，但需用户自行确认规则和价格，覆盖范围有限且随时间变化。适用场景主要面向独立制造商和小型团队，用于AI产品、SaaS或开发者工具的推广规划，也支持内容和代理产品，但渠道覆盖可能较窄。
items.quote: ReachMap 将产品画像转化为精准的渠道候选名单。
